hypothesis: The failed shared scalar reply-score head overpredicted rare beneficial alternatives. A model of each candidate versus static rank zero, with the static deficit explicit, may predict whether searched opponent response recovers that deficit more selectively.
arena: classic_generic_2022 procedural_v2 11x9 two-player reply-search-256/8/64 self-play, sample every fourth round
target: For each top-eight nonstatic whole-turn candidate, strict binary label reply_score(candidate)>reply_score(static rank zero), using the native full-opponent-turn search. Equality is not a positive label. These are conditional search targets, not terminal game outcomes.
representation: Frozen routed-v6 spatial encoder on actual next-active-player post-turn state plus 17 root-perspective material features for both candidate and static rank zero. Transform each static-score feature to asinh(score/1000) before fit-only z-score normalization. Concatenate normalized static, candidate and difference vectors so their initial static-score deficit is explicit.
model: Two-hidden-layer 128-ReLU pairwise logit classifier, deterministic seed72037, AdamW learning rate0.001 weight_decay0.01, 20 shuffled epochs of2048 pairs, binary cross entropy with fixed positive weight4.0 and equal map/position/alternative weighting. No validation-driven early stopping or architecture changes.
calibration: At most one choice per slate: highest candidate logit if its sigmoid exceeds a threshold, otherwise static rank zero. Test thresholds 0.50, 0.70, 0.90 on only the 128 calibration maps. Select the highest calibration net better-minus-worse subject to at least20 overrides and nonnegative net in each seat; ties favor the higher threshold. If none qualifies, reject without collecting fresh validation. Report all thresholds, not just the selected one.
offline_gate: On fresh validation maps report positive-pair precision/recall, per-seat selected native reply better/worse/same, teacher agreement, and paired independent-map sign test versus static rank zero. Require selected overrides>=20, better>worse overall and in each seat, and independent-map two-sided sign p<0.05 before confirmation. Confirmation repeats the same frozen model and threshold; no threshold retuning.
promotion: Even successful conditional reply-score validation/confirmation is not Elo. Freeze inference and require fresh complete-game both-seat matched independent-map games against plain beam and reply-search teacher with profile and runtime checks before any rating or browser deployment; preserve final seed6300000 until that stage.
resources: All training/data collection on SSH server only after aggregate resource check, bounded nice-19 single CPU, compressed tiny outputs, no other workload preemption or GPU unless safely free.
